TickerCopy(value, maxWords, maxChars) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (!text || text.includes('…') || text.includes('...')) return '';
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (words.length > Number(maxWords || 16)) return '';
  if (text.length > Number(maxChars || 112)) return '';
  return text;
}

function getTickerCopySizeClass(message) {
  const text = String(message || '').trim();
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  if (words <= 8 && text.length <= 58) return 'ticker-copy-short';
  if (words <= 12 && text.length <= 86) return 'ticker-copy-medium';
  return 'ticker-copy-long';
}

function conciseTickerText(value, maxChars) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const max = Math.max(58, Number(maxChars || 92));
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  return '';
}

function getPrayerTickerMessage(prayerTimes) {
  return choosePrayerMessage(prayerTimes) || '';
}

const ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS = [
  '🇶🇦 Doha is Qatar’s capital and largest city.',
  '🇶🇦 Qatar is a peninsula extending into the Arabian Gulf.',
  '🇶🇦 Qatar National Day is celebrated on 18 December.',
  '🇶🇦 The Qatari riyal is the national currency.',
  '🇶🇦 Arabic is Qatar’s official language.',
  '🇶🇦 Qatar hosted the FIFA World Cup in 2022.',
  '🇶🇦 Qatar was the first Middle Eastern country to host a FIFA World Cup.',
  '🇶🇦 The 2006 Asian Games were hosted in Doha.',
  '🇶🇦 Khor Al Adaid is known as Qatar’s Inland Sea.',
  '🇶🇦 Qatar has no permanent natural rivers.',
  '🇶🇦 Doha’s Corniche stretches along the city’s waterfront.',
  '🇶🇦 The oryx is an important national symbol in Qatar.'
];

let rotasticQatarFactIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length);
let rotasticMedicalStatCycleCount = 0;

function nextQatarFunFact() {
  const value = ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS[rotasticQatarFactIndex % ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length];
  rotasticQatarFactIndex = (rotasticQatarFactIndex + 1) % ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length;
  return value;
}

function getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats() {
  return Array.isArray(window.ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_STATS)
    ? window.ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_STATS.filter(function(x){ return x && x.text; })
    : [];
}

function chooseWeightedMedicalStat() {
  const regional = getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats().map(function(x) {
    const country = String(x.country || '').trim();
    let weight = Number(x.weight || 1);
    if (/qatar/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 8);
    else if (/saudi|uae|oman|kuwait|bahrain|jordan|lebanon|syria|iraq|pakistan/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 3);
    else if (/uk|united kingdom|england/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 2);
    return {country:country, weight:weight, text:String(x.text)};
  });

  const sourcePool = ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_STATS.concat(regional).filter(function(item){
    return item && String(item.text || '').trim();
  });
  if (!sourcePool.length) return '';

  // Build a fresh weighted shuffle bag only after the previous one is exhausted.
  if (!rotasticMedicalStatBag.length) {
    const weighted = [];
    sourcePool.forEach(function(item, sourceIndex) {
      for (let i=0; i<Math.max(1, Math.round(item.weight || 1)); i++) weighted.push(sourceIndex);
    });
    for (let i=weighted.length-1; i>0; i--) {
      const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      const tmp=weighted[i]; weighted[i]=weighted[j]; weighted[j]=tmp;
    }
    // De-duplicate adjacent copies caused by weighting while preserving weighting overall.
    const ordered=[];
    weighted.forEach(function(idx){
      if (!ordered.length || ordered[ordered.length-1] !== idx) ordered.push(idx);
    });
    // Ensure every unique stat gets a chance before repeats dominate.
    const uniques=sourcePool.map(function(_,i){return i;}).filter(function(i){return !ordered.includes(i);});
    rotasticMedicalStatBag = ordered.concat(uniques);
  }

  const index = rotasticMedicalStatBag.shift();
  return String(sourcePool[index] && sourcePool[index].text || '').trim();
}

function getSickAlertPriorityWindow(meta) {
  if (!meta || meta.kind !== 'sick' || !meta.date || !meta.shift) {
    return {active:false, reason:'not-sick'};
  }

  const shift = String(meta.shift || '').toUpperCase();

  let startMinutes = null;

  if (shift.indexOf('TWILIGHT AM') !== -1) {
    startMinutes = 9 * 60;          // 09:00
  } else if (shift.indexOf('TWILIGHT PM')

  if (text.length > Number(maxChars || 112)) return '';
  return text;
}

      const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      const tmp=weighted[i]; weighted[i]=weighted[j]; weighted[j]=tmp;
    }
    // De-duplicate adjacent copies caused by weighting while preserving weighting overall.
    const ordered=[];
    weighted.forEach(function(idx){
      if (!ordered.length || ordered[ordered.length-1] !== idx) ordered.push(idx);
    });
    // Ensure every unique stat gets a chance before repeats dominate.
    const uniques=sourcePool.map(function(_,i){return i;}).filter(function(i){return !ordered.includes(i);});
    rotasticMedicalStatBag = ordered.concat(uniques);
  }

  const index = rotasticMedicalStatBag.shift();
  return String(sourcePool[index] && sourcePool[index].text || '').trim();
}

Class(message) {
  const text = String(message || '').trim();
  const words = text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  if (words <= 8 && text.length <= 58) return 'ticker-copy-short';
  if (words <= 12 && text.length <= 86) return 'ticker-copy-medium';
  return 'ticker-copy-long';
}

function conciseTickerText(value, maxChars) {
  const text = String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const max = Math.max(58, Number(maxChars || 92));
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  return '';
}

let rotasticMedicalStatCycleCount = 0;

function nextQatarFunFact() {
  const value = ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS[rotasticQatarFactIndex % ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length];
  rotasticQatarFactIndex = (rotasticQatarFactIndex + 1) % ROTASTIC_QATAR_FUN_FACTS.length;

function getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats() {
  return Array.isArray(window.ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_STATS)
    ? window.ROTASTIC_REGIONAL_MEDICAL_STATS.filter(function(x){ return x && x.text; })
    : [];
}

function chooseWeightedMedicalStat() {
  const regional = getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats().map(function(x) {
    const country = String(x.country || '').trim();
    let weight = Number(x.weight || 1);
    if (/qatar/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 8);
    else if (/saudi|uae|oman|kuwait|bahrain|jordan|lebanon|syria|iraq|pakistan/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 3);
    else if (/uk|united kingdom|england/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 2);
    return {country:country, weight:weight, text:String(x.text)};
  });

  const sourcePool = ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_STATS.concat(regional).filter(function(item){
    return item && String(item.text || '').trim();
  });
  if (!sourcePool.length) return '';

  // Build a fresh weighted shuffle bag only after the previous one is exhausted.
  if (!rotasticMedicalStatBag.length) {
    const weighted = [];
    sourcePool.forEach(function(item, sourceIndex) {
      for (let i=0; i<Math.max(1, Math.round(item.weight || 1)); i++) weighted.push(sourceIndex);
    });
    for (let i=weighted.length-1; i>0; i--) {
      const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      const tmp=weighted[i]; weighted[i]=weighted[j]; weighted[j]=tmp;
    }
    // De-duplicate adjacent copies caused by weighting while preserving weighting overall.
    const ordered=[];
    weighted.forEach(function(idx){
      if (!ordered.length || ordered[ordered.length-1] !== idx) ordered.push(idx);
    });
    // Ensure every unique stat gets a chance before repeats dominate.
    const uniques=sourcePool.map(function(_,i){return i;}).filter(function(i){return !ordered.includes(i);});
    rotasticMedicalStatBag = ordered.concat(uniques);
  }

  const index = rotasticMedicalStatBag.shift();
  return String(sourcePool[index] && sourcePool[index].text || '').trim();
}

  const regional = getInjectedRegionalMedicalStats().map(function(x) {
    const country = String(x.country || '').trim();
    let weight = Number(x.weight || 1);
    if (/qatar/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 8);
    else if (/saudi|uae|oman|kuwait|bahrain|jordan|lebanon|syria|iraq|pakistan/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 3);
    else if (/uk|united kingdom|england/i.test(country)) weight = Math.max(weight, 2);
    return {country:country, weight:weight, text:String(x.text)};
  });

  const sourcePool = ROTASTIC_MEDICAL_STATS.concat(regional).filter(function(item){
    return item && String(item.text || '').trim();
  });
  if (!sourcePool.length) return '';

  // Build a fresh weighted shuffle bag only after the previous one is exhausted.
  if (!rotasticMedicalStatBag.length) {
    const weighted = [];
    sourcePool.forEach(function(item, sourceIndex) {
      for (let i=0; i<Math.max(1, Math.round(item.weight || 1)); i++) weighted.push(sourceIndex);
    });
    for (let i=weighted.length-1; i>0; i--) {
      const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
      const tmp=weighted[i]; weighted[i]=weighted[j]; weighted[j]=tmp;
    }
    // De-duplicate adjacent copies caused by weighting while preserving weighting overall.
    const ordered=[];
    weighted.forEach(function(idx){
      if (!ordered.length || ordered[ordered.length-1] !== idx) ordered.push(idx);
    });
    // Ensure every unique stat gets a chance before repeats dominate.
    const uniques=sourcePool.map(function(_,i){return i;}).filter(function(i){return !ordered.includes(i);});
    rotasticMedicalStatBag = ordered.concat(uniques);
  }

  const index = rotasticMedicalStatBag.shift();
  return String(sourcePool[index] && sourcePool[index].text || '').trim();
}

function getSickAlertPriorityWindow(meta) {
  if (!meta || meta.kind !== 'sick' || !meta.date || !meta.shift) {
    return {active:false, reason:'not-sick'};
  }

  const shift = String(meta.shift || '').toUpperCase();

  let startMinutes = null;

  if (shift.indexOf('TWILIGHT AM') !== -1) {
    startMinutes = 9 * 60;          // 09:00
  } else if (shift.indexOf('TWILIGHT PM') !== -1) {
    startMinutes = 14 * 60;         // 14:00
  } else if (shift.indexOf('AM SHIFT') !== -1 || shift === 'AM') {
    startMinutes = 7 * 60;          // 07:00
  } else if (shift.indexOf('PM SHIFT') !== -1 || shift === 'PM') {
    startMinutes = 16 * 60;         // 16:00
  } else if (shift.indexOf('FULL DAY') !== -1) {
    startMinutes = 7 * 60;          // treat full-day alert as starting with AM shift
  }

  if (startMinutes === null) {
    return {active:false, reason:'unknown-shift'};
  }

  const now = getQatarClock();

  // Priority applies only on the affected date.
  if (now.isoDate !== meta.date) {
    return {active:false, reason:'different-date'};
  }
